title: MIND: Lightweight and Effective Memory Injection Defense for LLM Agents via Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2607.28103v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Memory-augmented LLM-based agents are vulnerable to memory injection attacks: Agents may retrieve poisoned memory from attackers, which diverts their behavior from initial user intent and finally causes task failure. However, existing defense mechanisms either incur high computational cost or suffer from information redundancy in multi-turn contexts. To address these challenges, we propose Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising(MIND), a lightweight defense framework for memory injection attack. Our preliminary analysis reveals that benign and poisoned trajectories exhibit distinguishable relationships between the initial user intent and subsequent behavior. Building on this observation, MIND employs an intent-aware Information Bottleneck(IB) to extract compact intent--behavior representations from the initial intent and turn-level behavior. translated_title: MIND：基于意图感知信息瓶颈的轻量高效LLM智能体内存注入防御方法
translated_abstract: 基于内存增强的LLM智能体容易受到内存注入攻击：智能体可能从攻击者处检索到被投毒的记忆，这会使其行为偏离初始用户意图，最终导致任务失败。然而，现有的防御机制要么计算成本高昂，要么在多轮对话场景中存在信息冗余问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了记忆意图感知神经去噪方法（MIND），这是一个针对内存注入攻击的轻量级防御框架。我们的初步分析表明，良性轨迹与被投毒轨迹在初始用户意图和后续行为之间呈现出可区分的关系。基于这一观察，MIND采用意图感知的信息瓶颈（IB）从初始意图和轮级行为中提取紧凑的意图—行为表示。该信息瓶颈在过滤任务无关和冗余信息的同时，保留了与意图相关的跨轮攻击信号。
tldr: 提出MIND框架，利用意图感知信息瓶颈从初始意图与轮级行为中提取紧凑的意图—行为表示，在过滤冗余信息的同时保留跨轮攻击信号，实现对LLM智能体内存注入攻击的轻量高效防御。
en_tdlr: MIND is a lightweight defense framework against memory injection attacks on LLM agents, which employs an intent-aware Information Bottleneck to extract compact intent-behavior representations, preserving cross-turn attack signals while filtering task-irrelevant and redundant information.
